title: Eng lead sync brief — weekly prep + actions (Mira)
content: Purpose: quick prep notes for the weekly one-on-one with Alex (Eng Lead). Goal is to leave with 3 clear decisions and an owner-assigned follow-up list. Keep this lightweight — will surface blockers first, then alignment asks for API/Console/Dedicated/Private.
context: Recent spikes in latency on hosted-API routes during peak for chat endpoints used by the support chatbot. Console rollout for rollout-v2 UX is scheduled in 2 sprints but needs a gating checklist. Dedicated customers asked for predictable autoscaling guarantees; legal wants a short memo about on-prem compat for one target customer.
agenda: (5m) Quick sync — how are you feeling on capacity / blockers?
(10m) Hosted API latency: latest signal, short-term mitigations (KV cache tweaks, batch windows), longer-term instrumentation
(10m) Console rollout readiness: canary targets, telemetry hooks, rollback plan
(10m) Dedicated / Private asks: autoscaling SLO language + on-prem compatibility note
notes_to_bring_up: Observed: p95 token latency spiked from 150ms to 320ms on route /chat/generate between 03:30-04:10 PST on Wed — tied to heavier long-context requests.
Hypothesis: KV cache invalidation frequency + sudden influx of long-sequence requests starving batch slots; some backends falling back to fp32 path under memory pressure.
Telemetry gaps: need better per-route KV cache hit metric exposed in console and a synthetic that reproduces long-context path.
Console: rollout-v2 has missing telemetry hook for per-customer token-cost; ops wants ability to annotate routes with cost overrides during canary.
Dedicated: sales asked for SLA text for burst autoscaling — we need eng wording for what burst means (seconds/minutes, max extra GPUs) and failure modes.
asks_from_me: Can SRE drop a short-lived bypass to reduce KV invalidations for the next 48 hours during peak (temporary config)?
Can infra add a synthetic that uses 6k token sequences against /chat/generate and run every 10m in staging so we can reproduce p95 spike?
Eng lead: confirm whether we can ship console telemetry hook by next sprint or need to gate the rollout by 2 weeks.
Short draft of autoscaling SLA wording from eng side (2–3 bullets) by EOW so legal can bake it into customer comms.
open_risks: If KV cache bypass is too coarse we may regress latency for normal short requests — need targeted rule by route/length.
Console rollout without cost hooks may surface billing confusion and force rollbacks mid-canary.
Overpromising burst capacity in SLA without a tested failure mode could create an ops firefight during a real outage.
decision_needed: Agree on temporary mitigation for KV cache (config toggle vs targeted rule) and whether console rollout proceeds with telemetry partial (ship + feature-flag) or waits for full hook.
action_items: Alex: scope the KV cache toggle (route + token-length filter) and estimate time; update by 2026-03-11
Mira: open a short-run synthetic job in staging for long-context chat and add to linked_artifacts; complete by 2026-03-10
Jonah: draft 2–3 sentence autoscaling SLA wording for Dedicated and Private by 2026-03-12
SRE (named in Slack #sre): enable temporary config bypass during next peak window (48h) after Alex confirms approach
Alex + Mira: decide console rollout gate strategy (ship behind flag vs delay) by 2026-03-13
post_meeting_followup_template: Quick summary to paste into Slack and Confluence: 1) mitigation chosen for KV cache and who owns rollout, 2) synthetic job added and results link, 3) autoscaling SLA draft location, 4) console rollout decision and timeline. Tag stakeholders: #sre, #console, #dedicated-sales, legal-reviews.
